summary.ko: 동작 계약과 위험을 바탕으로 회귀·경계·실패 테스트를 구성합니다.
summary.en: Create behavior-focused tests covering regressions, boundaries, and meaningful failure modes.

exclusions: Bug diagnosis without a request or need to add tests
Load testing against external production targets

required_inputs.description: Expected behavior, relevant code, and existing tests if available
Test framework and available execution environment

workflow.instruction: Identify externally observable behavior and high-risk branches; inspect existing fixtures and test conventions.
Build a matrix covering normal, boundary, invalid, empty, permission, and failure scenarios that actually apply.
Author deterministic tests with isolated fixtures and explicit assertions; avoid snapshot-only checks for consequential logic.
Run available checks, distinguish passing, failing, and not-run tests, and connect each failure to the expected behavior.

deliverables.name: Test suite or cases
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Covers specified behavior using the existing framework or clearly labeled pseudocode

deliverables.name: Coverage rationale
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Maps risks and requirements to tests without inventing a coverage percentage

limitations: Passing tests do not prove absence of defects.
Do not claim tests executed when only authored or reviewed.
permission_boundaries: Use synthetic fixtures; do not exercise payments, email sends, or destructive production operations.
Changing CI configuration or installing packages requires the existing authorization path.
